exchange_rule: NYMEX Light Sweet Crude Oil futures, rule 200102.F
finding: The October-delivery contract must stop trading before September 25. A September 28 close for that contract is impossible under this rule, even though a selected news original states it. The exact last trading day is not needed for this conclusion.
effect: Withhold the October WTI level and change. Retain separately sourced Brent and physical-supply developments if their own evidence passes review.
scope: Rule checked after the saved edition cutoff. It is a development audit and a general exchange constraint, not a contemporaneous market-price source or permission to insert a replacement price.
